source.description: Choose one day per event occurrence, before day execution. Random uses relative positive weights; sequential advances on occurrence even if later blocked. See ENGINE_SEMANTICS.md section 6.

cooldown_days.description: After occurrence, skip this many subsequent eligible dates. Ineligible dates do not consume cooldown; changes to this setting do not rewrite remaining cooldown.

day.description: Persistent name, unique within its object type. Blueprint references and engine contracts use this name; never a UUID.

execution.description: Per-slot behavior: overlay, interrupt_main, or interrupt_lower (strictly lower event priority plus main). Daily start/end are not blocked. See ENGINE_SEMANTICS.md sections 7-8.

priority.description: Execution order is descending; nonnegative events precede the main day, negatives follow. Ties retain declaration order. Interruption targets are defined by execution, not priority alone.
